description: Strength for Today, Year 3. Scripture-grounded doctrinal revision drafts; not independently edited or approved for publication.

entries.title: Strength for Today — The Gospel for All
entries.reflection: Pray for open doors and speak respectfully to those who disagree. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when you need to apologise.
entries.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate when someone needs help; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: A church that seeks renewal must return to the Word, confess sin, and care for souls with compassion. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this while caring for another person.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You when someone needs help; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Purity of heart and separation from known sin must be joined to humility and love. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this within your family.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct when someone needs help; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The promises of God direct our attention to His faithfulness, not to guaranteed comfort. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this during a demanding day.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises when someone needs help; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Ask for a clean heart as well as an answer to your need. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when someone needs help.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance when someone needs help; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Salvation is received through Jesus Christ; repentance means turning from sin and trusting Him. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when you are tempted to respond sharply.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance when someone needs help; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Ask the Lord for wisdom instead of disguising presumption as faith. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this in a moment of uncertainty.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith when someone needs help; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Seek the Spirit's help for purity and faithful witness, not recognition or display. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this in your work or studies.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness when someone needs help; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Pray for open doors and speak respectfully to those who disagree. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when you need to apologise.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate when someone needs help; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Serve others without seeking attention or repayment. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this in a difficult conversation.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth when someone needs help; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Let the Word correct both your actions and your assumptions about others. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are misunderstood.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word when someone needs help; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: God invites His people to seek wisdom; discernment requires humility and attention to Scripture. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when a promise becomes costly.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture when someone needs help; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Readiness for eternity is not date-setting; it is persevering in holiness and faith. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when disappointment arises.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ when someone needs help; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — Love in Truth
entries.reflection: Welcome fellow believers while holding firmly to biblical teaching. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this as you consider your priorities.
entries.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth during a busy day; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You during a busy day; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.

topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct during a busy day; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises during a busy day; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.

topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance during a busy day; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.reflection: Religious activity cannot replace the new birth and sincere faith in Christ. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you encounter criticism.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance during a busy day; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.reflection: Trusting God does not remove the duty to work honestly and keep commitments. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when it is easier to keep silent.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith during a busy day; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Power for service does not cancel the need for humility or holy character. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when plans change.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness during a busy day; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Let personal conduct support the gospel you proclaim. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you make a private decision.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate during a busy day; help me practise what Scripture teaches. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth during a busy day; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: God's inspired Word is the final authority for Christian belief and conduct. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you examine your conscience.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word during a busy day; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Test advice by biblical truth rather than popularity or emotional pressure. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture during a busy day; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Let the hope of Christ's coming motivate compassion and evangelism. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this while caring for another person.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ during a busy day; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You when I am tempted to give up; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Purity of heart and separation from known sin must be joined to humility and love. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you encounter criticism.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct when I am tempted to give up; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: The promises of God direct our attention to His faithfulness, not to guaranteed comfort. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when it is easier to keep silent.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises when I am tempted to give up; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Ask for a clean heart as well as an answer to your need. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when plans change.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance when I am tempted to give up; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Salvation is received through Jesus Christ; repentance means turning from sin and trusting Him. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you make a private decision.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance when I am tempted to give up; help me reconcile where possible. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Ask the Lord for wisdom instead of disguising presumption as faith. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this as you consider your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith when I am tempted to give up; help me listen before answering. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Seek the Spirit's help for purity and faithful witness, not recognition or display. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you examine your conscience.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness when I am tempted to give up; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Pray for open doors and speak respectfully to those who disagree. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate when I am tempted to give up; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.

topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth when I am tempted to give up; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word when I am tempted to give up; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture when I am tempted to give up; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

entries.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth in an uncertain decision; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Pray for spiritual awakening without turning zeal into pride or treating others harshly. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this as you consider your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You in an uncertain decision; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: The grace that saves also teaches us to refuse ungodliness and practise righteousness. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you examine your conscience.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct in an uncertain decision; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: Speak courage without promising an outcome Scripture has not promised. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises in an uncertain decision; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Prayer expresses dependence on God and includes thanksgiving, confession, petition, and intercession. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this while caring for another person.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance in an uncertain decision; help me reconcile where possible. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Religious activity cannot replace the new birth and sincere faith in Christ. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this within your family.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance in an uncertain decision; help me listen before answering. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Trusting God does not remove the duty to work honestly and keep commitments. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this during a demanding day.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith in an uncertain decision; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Power for service does not cancel the need for humility or holy character. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when someone needs help.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness in an uncertain decision; help me show kindness in action. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Let personal conduct support the gospel you proclaim. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this when you are tempted to respond sharply.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate in an uncertain decision; help me take responsibility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Welcome fellow believers while holding firmly to biblical teaching. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this in a moment of uncertainty.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth in an uncertain decision; help me care for someone in need. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: God's inspired Word is the final authority for Christian belief and conduct. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this in your work or studies.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word in an uncertain decision; help me respond with humility. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture in an uncertain decision; help me choose truthful words. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.

topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ in an uncertain decision; help me act with patience. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.reflection: Let the hope of Christ's coming motivate compassion and evangelism. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you prepare for worship.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ when plans change; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.

entries.title: Strength for Today — A Heart Set Apart
entries.reflection: Let obedience at home and in ordinary duties demonstrate the holiness you profess. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when disappointment arises.
entries.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct in family conversations; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
topics.reflection: Let a desire for revival move you from religious routine to faithful service. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this when a promise becomes costly.
topics.prayer: Father, revive my devotion to You in family conversations; help me pray before reacting. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
topics.reflection: Let obedience at home and in ordinary duties demonstrate the holiness you profess. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this when disappointment arises.
topics.prayer: Father, teach me holiness in daily conduct in family conversations; help me remember Your faithfulness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
topics.reflection: God is our refuge in trouble; biblical hope rests in His character rather than easy circumstances. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you prepare for worship.
topics.prayer: Father, steady my hope in Your promises in family conversations; help me make time for Your Word. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Pray without ceasing.
topics.reflection: Pray for those who suffer and then consider what practical kindness you can offer. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you encounter criticism.
topics.prayer: Father, train me to pray with perseverance in family conversations; help me give thanks in every duty. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: ¶ Repent ye therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord;
topics.reflection: Where you have wronged another, consider appropriate restitution and truthful apology. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this when it is easier to keep silent.
topics.prayer: Father, lead me in sincere repentance in family conversations; help me seek wise counsel. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But without faith [it is] impossible to please [him]: for he that cometh to God must believe that he is, and [that] he is a rewarder of them that diligently seek him.
topics.reflection: Faithful believers may face trials; hardship is not proof that God has abandoned them. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this when plans change.
topics.prayer: Father, strengthen my obedient faith in family conversations; help me forgive rather than resent. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But ye shall receive power, after that the Holy Ghost is come upon you: and ye shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judæa, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth.
topics.reflection: Let the Word of God guide your understanding of spiritual experiences. Remember that faithful discipleship is lived daily. Consider this as you make a private decision.
topics.prayer: Father, fill me with courage to witness in family conversations; help me keep my commitments. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
topics.reflection: Care for people's needs without confusing charity with the message of salvation. Examine your own response before correcting another person. Consider this as you consider your priorities.
topics.prayer: Father, make my gospel witness compassionate in family conversations; help me speak with gentleness. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: By this shall all [men] know that ye are my disciples, if ye have love one to another.
topics.reflection: Jesus identifies His disciples by their love; unity must remain rooted in truth. Take one obedient step today and do not postpone it. Consider this as you examine your conscience.
topics.prayer: Father, help me love others in truth in family conversations; help me resist an easy compromise. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.
topics.reflection: Hearing Scripture without practising it can give a false sense of spiritual maturity. Let prayer lead to a truthful and practical choice. Consider this when you are asked for advice.
topics.prayer: Father, make me a doer of Your Word in family conversations; help me reconcile where possible. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all [men] liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.
topics.reflection: Do not treat every strong feeling as a message from God. Give thanks for the light of Scripture and follow it. Consider this while caring for another person.
topics.prayer: Father, grant me discernment from Scripture in family conversations; help me listen before answering. In Jesus' name, amen.

topics.bibleText: Therefore be ye also ready: for in such an hour as ye think not the Son of man cometh.
topics.reflection: Do not neglect today's responsibilities while speaking about the last days. Ask whether your decision reflects Christ's character. Consider this within your family.
topics.prayer: Father, keep me watchful for Christ in family conversations; help me serve without pride. In Jesus' name, amen.
